subject: Trial environment decision briefing + mop-up actions
messages:
From: markus.klein@redwood.inference
To: olivia.harper@lumenhealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-05-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial environment decision briefing + mop-up actions

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep the POC moving: 

1) Success criteria (we agreed to confirm):
   - 95th pct latency below 250ms for requests with 1k tokens
   - Embedding quality parity: > .92 cosine agreement on benchmark prompts
   - No data persistence beyond session in hosted mode; VPC trial to validate KMS integration

2) Environment options to evaluate (we discussed pros/cons):
   - Hosted API (fastest, no infra onboarding) — ideal for rapid feature validation
   - Dedicated sandbox (reserved GPUs) — predictable throughput for stress tests
   - VPC deployment (private control plane) — required if HIPAA is in scope

3) Proposed plan & timeline:
   - Week 0 (this week): sign PoE & SOW stub (Markus)
   - Week 1: hosted smoke test with 5 sample endpoints (Ben)
   - Week 2: dedicated sandbox run for peak-load test (Monica)
   - Week 3: if needed, VPC pilot kickoff (Lauren)

4) Owners & asks:
   - Olivia: confirm whether PHI will be involved (yes/no)
   - Procurement: push PoE to signatures (procurement@lumenhealth.com)
   - Redwood: share PoE and quick onboarding checklist (attached)

Attachments: LumenHealth_PoE.xlsx, redwood-poc-checklist.pdf

If that looks good I'll circulate a mutual action plan doc and calendar invites. 

Best,

Markus Klein
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.inference

From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@lumenhealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.inference
Cc: procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-09T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment decision briefing + mop-up actions

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear recap.

A few quick notes:
- We do anticipate PHI for a small subset during validation (de-identified customer transcripts + limited metadata). That likely pushes us toward VPC or a Private option with KMS.
- Our immediate priority is to validate latency and embedding alignment. The timelines you proposed work, but procurement will need two weeks for PoE/SOW review.
- Can you confirm that a hosted smoke test won't store any PHI and that logs can be disabled? If not, we'll need to start with Dedicated sandbox or VPC.

I'll loop procurement and follow up with a signed PoE once legal greenlights it. Also, can you provide a simple cost delta between dedicated sandbox and VPC pilot for planning?

Thanks,

Olivia Harper
Director, Applied ML — LumenHealth
olivia.harper@lumenhealth.com
From: ben.carter@redwood.inference
To: olivia.harper@lumenhealth.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.inference, monica.patel@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-05-09T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment decision briefing + mop-up actions

Hi Olivia — quick clarifications from the ops side:

- Hosted smoke test: logs can be disabled and we can disable any persistent KV caching for that tenant; session-only KV retained in memory and flushed after session. We will not persist PHI by default. I'll provide the exact log-retention toggle and a short doc.
- Cost deltas: rough estimates attached (redwood-poc-checklist.pdf includes base pricing sheet). High level: dedicated sandbox ~ 1.8x hosted for equivalent throughput; VPC pilot adds one-time setup + networking (~ 3x hosted in month 1, then ~2x steady-state). Precise numbers depend on instance size — we can pin after you share target RPS and token mix.

Action: Ben to run hosted smoke test template this week if PoE is signed; Monica to provision dedicated sandbox window for week 2.

-ben

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.inference
To: olivia.harper@lumenhealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference, markus.klein@redwood.inference, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference
Date: 2027-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment decision briefing + mop-up actions

Hi Olivia — thanks for the quick reply and the confirmation about PHI.

Short plan update given PHI: 
- We'll skip hosted smoke test if PHI present. Instead Monica will provision a dedicated sandbox with encrypted volumes and KMS key stub. 
- Lauren will own the VPC pilot readiness checklist (network peering, IP allowlist, audit logging). Expect a short questionnaire from her by EOD Monday.

Next steps for you: Please reply to procurement and mark the PoE as 'high priority' so we can align the sandbox window with their review. Once procurement confirms timing, we'll send calendar invites for the week 1/2 run.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference
